title: fix(approvals, list): a list cell waits for the record's approval lock before it edits, and a page's locks are read in one request (#35795)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3ktGWQBYiYJq1ThpuDKTbF)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXSK9qt8je9QbZvhKb

Fixes #35795

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表里直接改格子时：如果这条记录「是否被审批锁住」或「我能不能改这条」还没查回来，双击、回车、F2 或直接打字都不会立刻弹出编辑框，格子上先显示「正在确认这条记录能否编辑…」；答案一回来，没锁就自动打开编辑框（打的那个字也保留），锁了就显示「此记录正在审批中，已锁定。」。不会再出现「能进编辑、保存才被拒」。
- 查询中点了别的格子，就放弃这次等待，不会突然在别处弹出编辑框。查询中点开关、粘贴、清空：同样先提示正在确认，答案回来没锁才写入，锁了就不写并说明原因。
- 一页数据只发一个锁查询：第一次点格子时把整页的锁一起问；之后用方向键走动不再发请求。新增服务端批量接口 `POST /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/locks`（一次最多 200 条，读不到的记录和不存在的一样答 null），SDK 有对应方法。
- 风险：查询很慢时，用户第一次操作要等一下才出编辑框；没装审批服务的部署照旧（501 后不再问）。可直接撤回本 PR 回到原样。
- 需要你决定的：无。

## What changes

**Server (new route, contract, SDK).**
- `IApprovalService.getRecordLocks?(object, recordIds, context)` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`, optional like `getRecordLock`): entry `i` answers `recordIds[i]` exactly as `getRecordLock` answers it (`{ locked }`, or `null` for an unreadable or missing record, never told apart). New export `APPROVAL_RECORD_LOCKS_MAX_RECORD_IDS = 200` (the explain batch's cap, so a page splits the same way for both reads). `api-surface/contracts.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json` regenerated.
- `ApprovalService.getRecordLocks` (plugin-approvals): two engine reads whatever the page size: the caller's `id $in` read of the ids (the same anchor `getRecordLock` reads as the caller), then one pending-request lookup judged by the record-lock hook's own judgement through the new `recordsHeldByLockingApproval` (`lifecycle-hooks.ts`, the many-record form of `recordHeldByLockingApproval` over the same `lockingRequestsForRecords`).
- `POST /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/locks` (`approvals-routes.ts`): body `{ "recordIds": [...] }` answers `{ success: true, data: { records: [{ recordId, locked }] } }` in order, `locked: null` where the single read answers 404. Closed query set EMPTY (`APPROVAL_RECORD_LOCKS_PARAMS`); the body is closed too (`readRecordLocksBody`): any other key, a non-list, a non-string or blank id, an empty list or more than the cap is refused whole with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the service never asked. A service without `getRecordLocks` answers 501, never one `getRecordLock` per id. Route ledger row `sdk` → `client.approvals.getRecordLocks(object, recordIds)`.

**List grid.**
- `useRowApprovalLocks` asks the locks of the page in one request per `APPROVAL_RECORD_LOCKS_MAX_RECORD_IDS` ids when a cell is first selected (`ObjectGrid`'s `onCellSelect` passes the selected row plus the page's ids); rows already asked are not asked again, rows a later page brings are asked on the next select. It exposes `settling(recordId)`: the read the row waits on while it is on the wire.
- `useRecordCrudVerdicts` exposes `settling()`: the explain questions on the wire as one promise (read from a ref, so it sees a question sent since the last render).
- `ObjectGrid.describeCell`: when the cell has no read-only reason yet but the row's lock read, or its `update` verdict (when still unknown), is on the wire, the facts carry `checking: { text, settled }`.
- `@object-ui/components` `GridCellFacts.checking` (optional, new): `data-table`'s `attemptEdit` shows `text` on the cell, remembers the edit (with its typed seed) and asks it again when `settled` settles, unless another cell was selected, a newer edit was asked or an editor is open by then. A toggle, paste or clear asked meanwhile shows `text` and writes nothing (an intrinsic refusal such as "required" is still said first).
- i18n: `grid.readOnlyReason.checking` in all 11 locales plus the plugin's English fallback.

Docs: `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` ("Reading the locks of a page of records"). Changeset `.changeset/35795-batched-record-lock-read.md` (patch on the seven packages the diff moves; `Metadata-protocol: none` ⇒ patch).

## Why

PR #35747 read a row's lock with one `GET …/:recordId/lock` per selected row, sent on a double-click's first press and needed on its second. A slower answer let the editor open on a locked record and only the save was refused; the record verdict had the same window, and arrow keys sent one read per row (the L2 record 7034067196, S3 and N2). #35684 rules out 「能进编辑、保存被拒」.

**Batch route over projection** (premise, accepted by the seat with the claim 7072869185): the lock is the approvals plugin's own judgement; projecting it into `GET /data/:object` would teach the data layer about approvals or add a virtual-field protocol and charge every list read, while a batch route is the same shape as the explain batch the list already sends, asked only when the reader first acts on a cell.

## Small calls made in this thread (Sales 22:19:27Z: listed here)

- **Wait, then open** (the card's first arm) rather than "open nothing, say checking": the premise proposed the latter; building it showed that a real double-click on a fresh page (and every Playwright `dblclick`) would then always need a second double-click. The waiting edit is dropped by selecting another cell, so nothing opens elsewhere.
- The lock and verdict of a page are asked on the first cell select (lazy, the #34208 posture), not on first paint.
- The same cap as explain (200); a body with any other key is refused, like an unknown query name.
- A row the caller cannot read (`locked: null`) and a failed read fall back to the `approval_status` column (fail open, as before; the server still refuses a locked write).
- No principal key on the lock answers (unchanged from #35747): they are dropped on any data change of the object and on unmount.

## Verification

Each new pin was run against the fix, then with the fix ablated.

- `ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` "an edit waits for the row's lock and verdict (objectstack#35795)", 7 cases with fake timers for the slow reads: a slow lock read on a locked row says checking for 1999 ms and then locked, never an editor; on an unlocked row the editor opens by itself when it answers; a key typed while checking is the editor's value; a slow verdict holds it the same way; selecting another cell drops the wait; a page sends one lock read and the arrow keys send none (lock or explain); a 501 deployment is asked once and edits. The existing lock case now reads the page in one request. Ablating the `checking` branch of `attemptEdit`: 5 of the 7 red, restored.
- `rest-approvals-record-lock-route.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` for the route: preservation (service asked once with the ids in order and the caller; one entry per id; a full page at the cap), nine refusal shapes (400 + nested `VALIDATION_ERROR` + service never called), the empty closed query set, 501 when only `getRecordLock` exists (and it is not called), a read refusal relayed at its own status.
- `record-lock-read.integration.test.ts` (real ObjectQL + better-sqlite3 + `ApprovalsServicePlugin.start()`), new top-level `describe`: for each of submitter, approver and a non-participant reader, the page answer equals `getRecordLock` per id (repeated ids, unreadable, missing); two engine reads for a page of three; an outsider is refused 403 as for one record; a blank id answers null; deciding unlocks the page as the hook does.
- `client.test.ts`: one POST, object segment encoded, body `{ recordIds }`.
- Local runs on the merged tree: see the next section.

**Local runs** (merged tree, main `a5a5312f` + this branch, after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`):
- `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` test: 126 files / 1,812 passed. `@objectstack/client`: 59 / 820 passed. `@objectstack/spec`: 869 files / 27,877 passed. `@objectstack/rest`: first run 2 red (the two write-route ledgers had no row for the new POST route); rows added (`no-record-echo` in the #8497 tripwire, a driven `approvals.getRecordLocks` row in the hook-refusal ledger), both files now 737 / 737.
- Typecheck clean: rest, plugin-approvals, client, spec, ui plugin-grid, components, i18n.
- UI (`packages/plugin-grid/ components/ plugin-list/ plugin-detail/ i18n/`): first run 18 red in 4 files: a paste / toggle / digit was dropped while checking (fixed: those writes now wait too, as the edit does), and `zh-Hant.ts` was not regenerated (fixed with `gen:zh-hant`). The six affected files then 102 / 102. A second full run of these packages is in progress; its result goes on this PR.
- `spec check:generated`: `api-surface` and `export-origins` regenerated (one line each). `overlap-check.mjs`: clean against main and every open PR sharing a file (#36135, #36144, #36208).
- Added after the seat's ask: `ObjectGrid.autosave-35685.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` (2 cases, fake timers): a paste is not written for 1999 ms of a slow lock read and is written when it answers unlocked; on a locked answer it is never written and the cell says why. Ablating the wait in `writeCell`: both red, restored.

## Acceptance notes

- **#36135** (draft) makes `getRecordLock` also answer `true` for a `master_detail` line of a locked record. This PR's batch answers the record half only. Whichever lands second carries the other half into `getRecordLocks` (the line half batched: one FK read of the page, one lookup per master object). `overlap-check.mjs` reads this branch clean against #36135 (it was moved off the lines #36135 edits).
- The notice text stays on the cell until the answer arrives or the reader moves; it is not a toast.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (a contract interface member and a constant)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer's summary, in the maintainer's language).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
